lines.t: Blessed are those who run to The Lord,
They find their peace, they’re fully restored.
Love lifts them high, faith opens the door,
In His presence, they rise and soar.
Blessed are they who run and obey,
They find the truth and walk in His ways.
Their hearts are calm, their souls at ease,
Deliverance comes like a healing breeze.
The Word is a fire that sets us free,
A song of mercy for eternity.
When faith becomes the life we live,
Pride breaks, the heart forgives.
Blessed are they who run and obey,
They find the truth and walk in His ways.
Their hearts are calm, their souls at ease,
Deliverance comes like a healing breeze.
Oh, blessed ones, your joy complete,
Peace of Heaven beneath your feet.
In love’s embrace you find release,
Every storm fades into perfect peace.
Blessed are those who stand and sing,
Of mercy’s power and what love brings.
Running to The Lord, they’ll always know,
Deliverance shines and the blessings flow.
